snippet.title: Frozen Frontier - Horticular DLC Launch Trailer - Cozy Garden Game inspired by Viva Pinata
snippet.description:
Frozen Frontier, Horticular's first DLC, is out now on Steam!
Get it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3421790/Horticular__Frozen_Frontier/
Base Game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1928540/Horticular/


Horticular is a cozy garden building game inspired in part by games such as Viva Pinata!

You have been magically summoned by mysterious gnomes to restore a long-lost garden. Attract adorable animals, build a lush environment, and immerse yourself in this relaxing garden-builder. Will you manage to reclaim the wasteland or succumb to a looming corruption?

You can find the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1928540/Horticular/
